title: Authority transfer rollback template
description: ROUNDS-01-L03, DR-0003 decision P4. An authorityTransfer node's PR adds one filled copy per bounded context it lists, at docs/program/transfers/<leaf>-<context>.json (from S2; leaf-gate reads it from the PR head as data, and the operator passes it to #156's switch as the transfer record). It holds the 11 fields of spec 2703-2713, plus upgradeSource (the release a rollback returns to) and backupConsistency. Defaults (spec 2062-2067, decision P5): the final write freeze stays under 15 minutes, zero accepted writes are lost, recovery takes at most 30 minutes at the scale floor, and restore is rehearsed. A transfer may tighten a default; loosening one needs a deviations entry with the owner's approval. Fixtures hold synthetic values and placeholder digests only.

transfer.description: The authorityTransfer node: a leaf or stage ID from the context order in docs/program/cutover-policy.md.

context.description: One bounded context from that node's list.

rollbackDeadline.description: Spec 2703: until when the transfer can roll back to the legacy writer.

allowedDowntime.description: Spec 2704: the final write freeze and what readers see during it.

freezeMinutes.description: Longest final write freeze, in minutes: under 15 (spec 2062).

recoveryPointObjective.description: Spec 2705: accepted writes a rollback may lose; default 0 (spec 2063).

recoveryTimeObjective.description: Spec 2706: time to restore service at the stated scale; default 30 minutes at the scale floor (spec 2064-2065).

compatibility.description: Spec 2707: forward and reverse compatibility of application and schema versions, and the marker that refuses a mismatch (spec 2715).

finalWriteFreezeBoundary.description: Spec 2708: what the final freeze covers and the journal position it fences.

journal.description: Spec 2709: the replay or reverse-delta journal a rollback applies; it never silently discards post-switch changes (spec 2715-2716).

externalEffects.description: Spec 2710: treatment of public shares, exports, emails, and other external effects on rollback.

partialDeployDetection.description: Spec 2711: how a partial deployment (mixed versions) is detected and refused.

readModels.description: Spec 2712: read-model downgrade or rebuild on rollback.

decisionOwner.description: Spec 2713: who decides to roll back, and the leaf that owns the run.

upgradeSource.description: The release a rollback returns to: its tag, commit, and image digests. Digests are public release metadata; fixtures use placeholders.

backupConsistency.description: How the pre-transfer backup is made consistent, and the rehearsal that proves it restores (spec 2066-2067).

deviations.description: Each default this transfer loosens, with the owner's approval: value is the exact value the template uses, and default the bound it loosens (15, 0, 30, or true). Empty when every default holds.
